condition_direction: unit mean of within-block case-minus-control embedding contributions; GSE276529 is age-adjusted
attribution_direction: leave-one-donor/block-out, or leave-one-sample-out for unblocked contrasts; fallback to overall only if exclusion makes a contrast unidentifiable
target: dot product of pooled embedding and contrast direction
attribution: signed Integrated Gradients; all-zero baseline; midpoint Riemann
study_consensus: arithmetic mean of per-contrast signed IG scores after L1 absolute normalization
sensitivity: GSE211204 subjects with either primary endpoint in ARCHS4 train/validation removed
